alloy.preparation: Wrought UNS S32550 supplied as bar about 10 mm diameter; solution treated for 2 h at 1020 °C and water quenched. Outer material removed after annealing by machining to 8.5 mm rod. End face machined smooth, further wet ground to 4000-mesh finish and degreased. A subset received 1 µm finish for microscopy/microanalysis; individual assignment to the registered scan is not specified.
alloy.microstructure: Duplex stainless steel: Table 2 lists 47% ferrite and 53% austenite for 1020 °C treatment. Austenite grains in ferrite matrix; both grain sizes increase with annealing temperature. Ferrite enriched in Cr/Mo, austenite enriched in Ni/Cu. Phase compositions are distinct from bulk cast composition.

test_solution.preparation: Hot 3.5% NaCl solution; percentage basis, solvent grade, bulk pH and gas conditioning are not stated. The water bath controls cell temperature; it is not an explicit solvent specification.

test_method.procedure_description: Glass three-electrode cell in 65 °C water bath; rod held from lid with only end face just touching solution surface to define exposed area and avoid side crevices. Platinum-wire counter; saturated calomel reference at the same solution temperature. Potentiodynamic anodic sweep at 1 mV/s; all potentials versus SCE. Some samples were etched after testing for 3 s in 40% KOH at 2 V to distinguish ferrite/austenite and examine pits; this is post-test characterization. The coupled-electrode ZRA/CPT test in FeCl3 is a separate method.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Ep is the potential at which current density exceeded 50 µA/cm². Reported pits initiated in ferrite or on the ferrite side of ferrite–austenite boundaries; no independent phase-specific numerical pitting potential is assigned.

experiments.result_note: Explicit text pitting potential. The experimental criterion is current density exceeding 50 μA/cm² during a 1 mV/s sweep. The source reports preferential ferrite-phase initiation; no phase-specific numerical potential is separately assigned. Bulk chemistry uses the full Table 1 cast analysis. Table 2 separately gives phase analyses and an average of both phases (e.g. Cr 25.06, Ni 5.89, Mo 2.97 wt%), differing from the cast analysis; they are not silently substituted or averaged into a new composition. Ferrite N≈0.05% is the authors’ phase-partition assumption, not a measured bulk composition. All four Ep statements concern the 2 h/water-quenched series; separate 1060 °C/5 h water/oil CPT comparisons are not imported. No Fe balance, NaCl basis conversion, chloride concentration or pH is calculated.
